scope: Linear HDR output (tone mapped once), glass as a Cycles-fitted transmitting/reflecting slab, and environment specular from newly baked reflection probes (what glossy rays see) for all probe-lit materials and the water surface. GLB, scene definition, irradiance probes, lights and exposure unchanged.
conditions: Chrome 154.0.8037.57 headless, macOS, localhost production build, 1200x800 (Cycles cameras) / 1280x800 (survey), DPR 1, standard quality, reduced motion, muted, DOM stage effects excluded for the Cycles cameras.

hashes.input_blend: edf3c35b93e162afe66786f626423bb42aeeb813c049930681586ee1fdfba6af (unchanged after the bake and every Blender run)

reflection_bake.note: Same 4,832-probe grids, 64x32 panoramas, 64 samples. The machine appears to have slept during the evening courtyard grid (5,254 s for 2,375 probes; the other grids ran at 0.17-0.4 s/probe).

lights_in_probes.day: V10 day lights (deck edges x3, lounge dusk fill, path grazing x3, specimen uplight), V7 concealed backrest wash, V7 water reflection soft strip, V8 maple garden grazing light
lights_in_probes.evening: V10 deck edges x3, V7 backrest wash, V7 water strip, V8 maple light (V10 lounge fill, path lights and uplight are drawn by the browser)

glass_cycles_measurement.method: Source 'Low iron architectural glass' on an 18 mm slab, Cycles CPU 512 samples, orthographic camera; T: white emitter behind, black world; R: white world without emitter minus T.
glass_cycles_measurement.model: T = (1-F)^2 t / (1 - F^2 t), R = F + F T (F exact dielectric Fresnel, IOR 1.45, t base color): within 0.01 at every angle. Tinting at both refractions (t^2) gave T red 0.71 at normal incidence.

linear_components_day.note: browser/Cycles luminance on the surface mask (same method and Cycles EXRs as leaf-transmission). Glass factor = region luminance with / without glass and water.

specular_by_brightness.note: browser/Cycles specular in the darkest and brightest quartile of Cycles surface luminance (7x7 px blocks)

cycles_tone_stats.columns: source 7: mean dL*, mean |dL*|, percentile |dL| all, mean dC*, green |dC| / evening 6: same

survey: 144 views: draw calls and triangles identical to leaf-transmission (the double-sided transparent glass was two passes, now transmission + reflection), textures +4 (three reflection 3D textures and the HDR target), geometries +1 (full-screen triangle).
tests: tsc, 30 files / 157 unit tests, lint, format, build; test:browser 12 passed (2.9 min); test:browser:visual 3 passed (survey, Cycles cameras, capture stability; about 108 s). 5-minute soak, devices, GPU time not run.
